[u]
Events
[/u]Penny 1 Heart Event: Enter the town between 0600-2400 (6am-12am) on a sunny day
Penny 3 Heart Event: Enter Museum between 0600-2400 (6am-12am)
Penny 5 Heart Event: Enter the town between 0600-2400 (6am-12am) on a sunny day
Penny 7 Heart Event: Enter the Museum between 0600-2400 (6am-12am)
Penny 9 Heart Event: Enter the town between 0600-1700 (6am-5pm) on a sunny day

Penny 10 Heart (2700) Married Event: Enter bus stop between 0600-2200 (6am-10pm) on a sunny day
Penny 10 Heart (2800) Married Event: Enter bus stop between 0600-2200 (6am-10pm) on a sunny day
Penny 10 Heart (2900) Married Event: Enter bus stop between 0600-2200 (6am-10pm) on a sunny day

Linus 4 Heart, Penny 8 Heart Event: Enter the mountain zone between 1800-2200 (6pm-10pm) during Winter
Maru 2 Heart, Penny 2 Heart Event: Enter the museum between 0800-2000 (8am-8pm)
Pam 2 Heart, Penny 2 Heart Event: Enter the Saloon/Bar between 1800-2400 (6pm-12am) on a Friday
Pam 4 Heart, Penny 4 Heart Event: Enter the town between 0600-2400 (6am-12am) on a sunny day
Pam 7 Heart, Penny 4 Heart Event: Enter bus stop between 0800-1800 (8am-6pm)

Abigail 2 Heart, Sebastian 2 Heart, Sam 2 Heart, Penny 2 Heart: Enter the Saloon/Bar between 1800-2300 (6pm-11pm) on any day NOT Friday
Abigail 4 Heart, Sebastian 6 Heart, Sam 4 Heart, Penny 6 Heart: Enter the town between 0600-1800 (6am-6pm) on a sunny day
Abigail 4 Heart, Sebastian 4 Heart, Sam 6 Heart, Penny 6 Heart: Enter the town between 1600-2000 (4am-8pm) on a sunny day
Abigail 7 Heart, Maru 7 Heart, Sebastian 7 Heart, Sam 7 Heart, Penny 8 Heart: Enter Penny's Home between 1700-2100 (5pm-9pm)
